landing.heroSubtitle: Configure TitanBot effortlessly with a modern, real-time web dashboard. Manage welcome messages, audit logs, command permissions, and multilingual localization in seconds.
landing.feature1Desc: Seamless support for English, Latin American Spanish, and German across all 100 slash commands and the web dashboard.
landing.feature2Desc: Automated welcome cards with live Discord preview and instant starter role assignment for newcomers.
landing.feature3Desc: Centralized server audit channels, user reports, verification gates, and permission management.
landing.feature4Desc: Enable or disable entire command categories or individual slash commands per server with a single click.

servers.title: Select a Server to Manage
servers.subtitle: You can configure any server where you have Administrator or Manage Server permissions.
servers.noServersHelp: You need to be the owner or have Administrator / Manage Server permissions on a server to manage it here.

general.title: General Settings
general.subtitle: Customize core bot settings, language, text command prefix, and elevated management roles.
general.botLanguageHelp: Controls the language TitanBot uses for command replies and embeds on this server.
general.botPrefixHelp: Prefix used for legacy text commands (1-5 characters). Default is '!'.
general.adminRoleHelp: Members with this role can run bot administrator commands.
general.modRoleHelp: Members with this role can execute moderation commands like /ban, /kick, and /timeout.

welcome.title: Welcome & Auto-Role
welcome.subtitle: Greet new community members with personalized messages and automatically assign starter roles.
welcome.channelHelp: The text channel where welcome greeting cards will be posted.
welcome.messageHelp: Customize your greeting. You can use variables: {user}, {server}, {memberCount}.
welcome.autoRoleHelp: The role given to members immediately when they join the server.
welcome.autoRolesHelp: Roles automatically assigned to newcomers upon joining the server.
welcome.placeholdersNote: Variables {user}, {server}, and {memberCount} will be dynamically rendered when a user joins.

logging.title: Logs & Audit
logging.subtitle: Track important server events, moderation actions, and user reports in dedicated channels.
logging.enableLoggingHelp: Toggle server activity logging on or off.
logging.auditChannelHelp: Channel where moderation actions and server audit entries will be recorded.
logging.reportsChannelHelp: Channel where member reports and flags are logged.
logging.applicationsChannelHelp: Channel where staff and team applications are routed.
logging.ignoredChannelsHelp: Message edits and deletions in these channels will not be audited.
logging.addIgnoredChannelHelp: Select a channel to exclude from audit logs.
logging.noIgnoredChannels: No ignored channels. All channels generate audit logs.

categories.moderationDesc: Bans, kicks, mutes, warnings, and message purges.
categories.messageDesc: Message edits, deletions, and bulk purges.
categories.roleDesc: Role creations, updates, and permission changes.
categories.levelingDesc: Chat rank promotions and role reward unlocks.
categories.giveawayDesc: Giveaway launches, winner picks, and rerolls.

commands.title: Command Manager
commands.subtitle: Enable or disable entire command categories or individual slash commands on your server.
commands.searchPlaceholder: Search commands by name or description...

verification.title: Server Verification
verification.subtitle: Protect your community by requiring new members to complete a verification check before gaining access.
verification.verificationHelp: When enabled, newcomers will need to complete verification before interacting in the community.
verification.unverifiedRoleHelp: Temporary role assigned on join until the user verifies.
verification.channelHelp: Text channel where the verification panel message will be sent.
verification.panelMessageHelp: Explanatory embed message for members awaiting verification.
verification.panelMessagePlaceholder: Click the button below to verify and gain access to the server.
verification.publishedSuccess: Verification panel published successfully to Discord!
verification.autoVerifyHelp: Automatically verify new members whose Discord accounts exceed a specific age threshold.
verification.minAccountAgeHelp: Minimum account age in days required for instant auto-verification (e.g. 7 days).
verification.conflictWarning: Concurrency Notice: If AutoRole is active, members will receive their role immediately upon joining without waiting for verification.
verification.howItWorksDesc: When verification is active, newcomers arriving in your server are greeted with a verification prompt (or button panel). Completing the check verifies the member and grants them full access to the community channels.
verification.step1Desc: User is restricted from interacting until verified.
verification.step2Desc: User interacts with the verify modal or button.
verification.step3Desc: Member is verified and member role is assigned.

roles.title: Reaction Roles
roles.subtitle: Create interactive panels for server members to self-assign roles via dropdown menus.
roles.noPanels: No reaction role panels created in this server yet.
roles.channelHelp: The text channel where the panel message will be posted.
roles.selectRolesHelp: Select roles that will be available for self-assignment (maximum 25).
roles.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this panel? The Discord message will also be removed.
roles.atLeastOneRole: You must add at least one role before publishing.

tickets.title: Ticket System
tickets.subtitle: Build and deploy interactive support panels to serve your community.
tickets.panelNotPublishedDesc: Customize the options below and click Publish to send it to Discord.
tickets.confirmDeletePanel: Are you sure you want to delete the active ticket panel?
tickets.publishSuccess: Ticket panel successfully published to Discord!

tickets.categoryHelp: Category where new ticket channels will be created.
tickets.closedCategoryHelp: Category where closed tickets will be archived.

tickets.buttonLabelHelp: Text shown on the button users click in Discord.
tickets.defaultPanelMessage: To open a support ticket, click the button below. Our team will get back to you shortly.
tickets.staffRoleHelp: This role will be granted read/write permissions in created ticket channels.

tickets.maxTicketsHelp: Maximum concurrent open tickets allowed per user (1-10).

leveling.subtitle: Reward chat activity with experience points (XP), levels, and automatic role rewards.
leveling.enableLevelingHelp: Members earn experience when chatting and can unlock role rewards.
leveling.announceLevelUpHelp: Sends a congratulatory message each time a member reaches a new level.
leveling.channelHelp: Select a fixed channel for announcements. If "None", it will announce in the active chat channel.
leveling.multiplierHelp: Scale the speed at which your community levels up.
leveling.cooldownHelp: Minimum time between messages to grant XP points.
leveling.roleRewardsHelp: Automatically grant Discord roles to members when reaching a target level.
